findings.body: The new test checks description substrings and the first six command names, but never compares complete help output. Changing `--out`'s metavar or help, removing an option description, or changing top-level help text would still pass these assertions. Item 2 explicitly requires unchanged `forge --help` and command help. Extend this entry-point test with independent baseline expectations for the complete output, including arguments and usage.
findings.title: Not done: test unchanged help output

findings.body: `ast.literal_eval` cannot evaluate callable argument converters such as `int`. The existing `close --dismiss` argument uses `type=int` in `src/forge/cli.py:49`; expressing that same argument tuple in `COMMANDS` raises `ValueError` here and prevents every command, including `--help`, from starting. The promised declaration format therefore cannot represent all current argument tuples. Support these argument values and exercise a typed argument through the fixture command.
findings.title: Support existing argument converters in declarations

findings.body: Item 2 remains partially incomplete: this fallback still consumes the central `TABLE`, and group help remains in `GROUPS`. The remaining commands do not yet declare their position and listing in their owning modules. `plans/FORGE-SPLIT-1.md:41` assigns this migration to COMMANDS, and lines 63–64 explicitly permit the interim table, so this is deferred P2 advice rather than a merge-blocking requirement for COLLECTOR.
